articles.author: Swvl Holdings Corp
articles.headline: Swvl Announces $13 Million Strategic Investment Round Priced At-The-Market Under Nasdaq Rules led by the Sawiris Family and Coefficient LP to Anchor Its Next Phase of Growth and U.S. Expansion
articles.summary: Swvl announced a definitive agreement for a$13 million private placement led by Coefficient, with proceeds intended for growth including US expansion. Signing and planned funding are distinguished from completed closing.
